subject: Insurance
title: Variable Life: Insurance Meets Wall Street
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Variable Life: Insurance Meets Wall Street.

hook.text: Variable life lets you invest the cash value in stocks and bonds. Your policy grows with the market—or crashes with it.

buildup.text: Policyholders choose from a menu of investment funds. Bull markets can double the cash value in years.

discovery.text: The death benefit can increase if investments perform well. It combines insurance protection with market upside.

twist.text: In 2008, variable life policyholders watched their cash values collapse.

climax.text: Variable life is for people who want market exposure inside insurance.

punchline.text: Invest inside your policy. If the market crashes, so does your coverage.

quiz.question: What makes variable life insurance risky?
options: Cash value depends on stock market performance
